entries.title: Numbers 15:1
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 15:2
segments: Say to the children of Israel, When you have come into the land which I am giving to you for your resting-place,

entries.title: Numbers 15:3
segments: And are going to make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burned offering or an offering in connection with an oath, or an offering freely given, or at your regular feasts, an offering for a sweet smell to the Lord, from the herd or the flock:

entries.title: Numbers 15:4
segments: Then let him who is making his offering, give to the Lord a meal offering of a tenth part of a measure of the best meal mixed with a fourth part of a hin of oil:

entries.title: Numbers 15:5
segments: And for the drink offering, you are to give with the burned offering or other offering, the fourth part of a hin of wine for every lamb.

entries.title: Numbers 15:6
segments: Or for a male sheep, give as a meal offering two tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with a third part of a hin of oil:

entries.title: Numbers 15:7
segments: And for the drink offering give a third part of a hin of wine, for a sweet smell to the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 15:8
segments: And when you make ready a young ox for a burned or other offering, or for the effecting of an oath, or for peace-offerings to the Lord:

entries.title: Numbers 15:9
segments: Then with the ox give a meal offering of three tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with half a hin of oil.

entries.title: Numbers 15:10
segments: And for the drink offering: give half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 15:11
segments: This is to be done for every young ox and for every male sheep or he-lamb or young goat.

entries.title: Numbers 15:12
segments: Whatever number you make ready, so you are to do for every one.

entries.title: Numbers 15:13
segments: All those who are Israelites by birth are to do these things in this way, when giving an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 15:14
segments: And if a man from another country or any other person living among you, through all your generations, has the desire to give an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord, let him do as you do.

entries.title: Numbers 15:15
segments: There is to be one law for you and for the man of another country living with you, one law for ever from generation to generation; as you are, so is he to be before the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 15:16
segments: The law and the rule are to be the same for you and for those from other lands living with you.

entries.title: Numbers 15:17
segments: And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 15:18
segments: Say to the children of Israel, When you come into the land where I am guiding you,

entries.title: Numbers 15:19
segments: Then, when you take for your food the produce of the land, you are to give an offering lifted up before the Lord.

entries.title: Numbers 15:20
segments: Of the first of your rough meal you are to give a cake for a lifted offering, lifting it up before the Lord as the offering of the grain-floor is lifted up.

entries.title: Numbers 15:21
segments: From generation to generation you are to give to the Lord a lifted offering from the first of your rough meal.

entries.title: Numbers 15:22
segments: ¶And if in error you go against any of these laws which the Lord has given to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 15:23
segments: All the laws which the Lord has given you by the hand of Moses, from the day when the Lord gave them, and ever after from generation to generation;

entries.title: Numbers 15:24
segments: Then, if the wrong is done in error, without the knowledge of the meeting of the people, let all the meeting give a young ox as a burned offering, a sweet smell to the Lord, with its meal offering and its drink offering, as is ordered in the law, together with a he-goat for a sin-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 15:25
segments: So the priest will make the people free from sin, and they will have forgiveness; for it was an error, and they have given their offering made by fire to the Lord, and their sin-offering before the Lord, on account of their error:

entries.title: Numbers 15:26
segments: And all the meeting of the children of Israel, as well as those from other lands living among them, will have forgiveness; for it was an error on the part of the people.

entries.title: Numbers 15:27
segments: And if one person does wrong, without being conscious of it, then let him give a she-goat of the first year for a sin-offering.

entries.title: Numbers 15:28
segments: And the priest will take away the sin of the person who has done wrong, if the wrong was done unconsciously, and he will have forgiveness.

entries.title: Numbers 15:29
segments: The law in connection with wrong done unconsciously is to be the same for him who is an Israelite by birth and for the man from another country who is living among them.

entries.title: Numbers 15:30
segments: ¶But the person who does wrong in the pride of his heart, if he is one of you or of another nation by birth, is acting without respect for the Lord, and will be cut off from his people.

entries.title: Numbers 15:31
segments: Because he had no respect for the word of the Lord, and did not keep his law, that man will be cut off without mercy and his sin will be on him.

entries.title: Numbers 15:32
segments: Now while the children of Israel were in the waste land, they saw a man who was getting sticks on the Sabbath day.

entries.title: Numbers 15:33
segments: And those who saw him getting sticks took him before Moses and Aaron and all the people.

entries.title: Numbers 15:34
segments: And they had him shut up, because they had no directions about what was to be done with him.

entries.title: Numbers 15:35
segments: Then the Lord said to Moses, Certainly the man is to be put to death: let him be stoned by all the people outside the tent-circle.

entries.title: Numbers 15:36
segments: So all the people took him outside the tent-circle and he was stoned to death there, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.

entries.title: Numbers 15:37
segments: ¶And the Lord said to Moses,

entries.title: Numbers 15:38
segments: Say to the children of Israel that through all their generations they are to put on the edges of their robes an ornament of twisted threads, and in every ornament a blue cord;

entries.title: Numbers 15:39
segments: So that, looking on these ornaments, you may keep in mind the orders of the Lord and do them; and not be guided by the desires of your hearts and eyes, through which you have been untrue to me:

entries.title: Numbers 15:40
segments: And that you may keep in mind all my orders and do them and be holy to your God.

entries.title: Numbers 15:41
segments: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, so that I might be your God: I am the Lord your God.
